tool_arguments.query: NVIDIA Data Center revenue Q3 fiscal 2027 ending October 2026

events.content: NVIDIA Data Center revenue Q3 fiscal 2027 ending October 2026

NVIDIA has not yet reported Data Center revenue for Q3 fiscal 2027 (the quarter ending in October 2026); its Q3 FY2027 earnings release is scheduled for November 17, 2026. [[1]] 

The latest reported Data Center revenue is **$89.0 billion** for Q2 fiscal 2027, reported on August 26, 2026. [[2]]

tool_arguments.query: Qualcomm Snapdragon smartphone chip revenue Q2 fiscal 2027

events.content: Qualcomm Snapdragon smartphone chip revenue Q2 fiscal 2027

AMD has not yet reported Q2 fiscal 2027 results. Its most recently reported second quarter is Q2 2026, when Data Center revenue was **$6.7 billion** (specifically **$6.718 billion**), up **107% year over year**. [[1]]

Related coverage:
On a **global smartphone application-processor/system-on-chip (AP/SoC) shipment basis**, Qualcomm held **23%** market share in **Q1 2026**, versus Apple at **19%**; Qualcomm therefore led Apple by **4 percentage points**. [[1]] 

For context, Qualcomm’s share declined from **27% in Q1 2025** to 23%, while Apple rose from **15%** to 19% over the same period. [[1]] 

This is **chipset shipment share**, not smartphone-brand market share or semiconductor revenue share; Apple’s chips are principally used in its own iPhones, whereas Qualcomm supplies numerous Android OEMs. [[2]]
